text:
Zara N: Hey all — starting today! Quick hit: I clicked the Okta activation link but Okta Verify QR gives 'no matching profile' and push never arrives. Also 1Password invite not in my inbox. Anyone seen this pattern?

Marta (IT): Welcome Zara :tada: Sorry for the hiccup. Can you share the exact email you used? Sometimes Workspace provisioning lags and the identity provider hasn't finished syncing.

Zara N: zara.n@redwood.com. I do see a Google account but Drive shows 'access denied'.

it-ops-bot: Provisioning update — workspace account created for zara.n@redwood.com; group memberships: product, onboarding. Google Drive group sync queued (est. 12 mins).

Sam: Hi Zara, I'm on product. If you need any repo links before Drive shows up I can DM you the raw links.

Marta (IT): Thanks — I'm reissuing the Okta activation and re-sending 1Password. Two quick workarounds: 1) use the Okta web UI and 'Set up factor' to get a QR/TOTP; 2) request a one-time backup code from the sign-in screen.

Zara N: Tried the web path and got 'Factor enrollment failed: provisioning incomplete'.

Marta (IT): Aha — provisioning job was stuck on our side, cleared it. Please try the web flow again in 2 min. If it still errors, reply here and I'll flip a temporary SMS factor so you can finish setup.

it-ops-bot: 1Password invite resent to zara.n@redwood.com.

Zara N: Got the 1Password invite this time. Used backup code to sign in and then enrolled Okta Verify successfully. Drive access appeared ~8 minutes after the bot message. All good now, thanks! :smile:

Sam: Welcome aboard! I'll add you to the product docs and ping for a quick intro.

Marta (IT): If anyone else hits similar errors: first step is check provisioning status (it-ops-bot), then try web enrollment or backup code. We'll follow up to see why the provisioning queue stalled.

Zara N: Appreciate the help — joining the intro call in a bit :)
